about: Reference design values (allowable stress design, normal load duration, dry service) of sawn dimension lumber 2 to 4 inches thick, for framing_check (crates/core/src/framing/check.rs). Values in psi as published. fb: bending, by the actual depth (mm) a row holds up to (the last row: any deeper); size_factor: what fb is multiplied by, by depth, where the table gives one reference value for every width (none: 1.0, the size factor being in fb's rows already); fv: shear parallel to grain; e: modulus of elasticity.

woods.name: Douglas Fir-Larch No. 2
woods.source: AWC NDS 2018 Supplement, Table 4A (visually graded dimension lumber), Douglas Fir-Larch No. 2; size factor CF for Fb from Table 4A's adjustment factors (2 in and 3 in thick)

woods.name: Southern Pine No. 2
woods.source: AWC NDS 2018 Supplement, Table 4B (visually graded Southern Pine dimension lumber, the values effective June 1, 2013; size factor included by width, and 0.9 of the 12 in value wider than 12 in), Southern Pine No. 2

woods.name: Plantation pine (assumed values)
woods.source: An assumption, from no standard: values set below the NDS No. 2 softwoods above, with Table 4A's size factors, for a fast-grown plantation pine (Pinus patula, P. caribaea, P. oocarpa) until the local standard's are put in their place: in Colombia NSR-10 Titulo G's for the wood's structural group, or a grading agency's for the lumber bought
